## Service: snapshots (Snapshots API)

Documentation for Snapshots API

### Create Snapshot Share Link
POST /snapshots/share/link
URL: https://services.leadconnectorhq.com/snapshots/share/link
Docs: https://marketplace.gohighlevel.com/docs/ghl/snapshots/create-snapshot-share-link | Markdown: https://marketplace.gohighlevel.com/docs/ghl/snapshots/create-snapshot-share-link.md

Create a share link for snapshot

Auth: Agency token: OAuth access token or Private Integration Token. Scopes: none

Headers:
- Authorization: Bearer <token> (required)
- Version: v3 (required)

Query parameters:
- companyId* string

Request body (required) (application/json) CreateSnapshotShareLinkRequestDTO:
- snapshot_id* string (e.g. "1eM2UgkfaECOYyUdCo9Pa") - id for snapshot to be shared
- share_type* string (enum: link | permanent_link | agency_link | location_link; e.g. "permanent_link") - Type of share link to generate
- relationship_number string (e.g. "0-128-926,1-208-926,2-008-926") - Comma separated Relationship number of Agencies to create agency restricted share link
- share_location_id string (e.g. "l1C08ntBrFjLS0elLIYU, U1C08ntBrFjLS0elKIYP") - Comma separated Sub-Account ids to create sub-account restricted share link

Response 201 (Successful response) application/json:
- id string - id for shared snapshot
- shareLink string - Share Link for snapshot

Errors: 400, 401 (400, 401: see Common error responses)

### Get Snapshot Push between Dates
GET /snapshots/snapshot-status/{snapshotId}
URL: https://services.leadconnectorhq.com/snapshots/snapshot-status/{snapshotId}
Docs: https://marketplace.gohighlevel.com/docs/ghl/snapshots/get-snapshot-push | Markdown: https://marketplace.gohighlevel.com/docs/ghl/snapshots/get-snapshot-push.md

Get list of sub-accounts snapshot pushed in time period

Auth: Agency token: OAuth access token or Private Integration Token. Scopes: none

Headers:
- Authorization: Bearer <token> (required)
- Version: v3 (required)

Path parameters:
- snapshotId* string (e.g. "39It2BFz7EkNaNBALPif")

Query parameters:
- companyId* string (e.g. "5D112kQsiKESj6rash")
- from* string (e.g. "2022-10-10T12:00:00Z or 2022-10-10") - Only accepts ISO 8601 format
- to* string (e.g. "2023-12-18T11:59:59Z or 2023-12-18") - Only accepts ISO 8601 format
- lastDoc* string (e.g. "VUJO4Sw2TrDNZ5lx4wZg") - Id for last document till what you want to skip
- limit string (e.g. "10") - Limit of documents to return. Default is 20

Response 200 (Successful response) application/json:
- data object[]
  - id string - Document id
  - locationId string - Sub-account id
  - status string - Status of snapshot push
  - dateAdded string (format: date-time) - Timestamp of when snapshot processing starts for sub-account

Errors: 400, 401 (400, 401: see Common error responses)
